# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 33 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 11 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens; Shadow — 7 tokens; Duration — 3 tokens; Easing — 2 tokens.

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--fg, #121621);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--fg, #eceef4);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #121621;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--fg` | #121621 | #eceef4 | All body text and titles, on bg, panel, panel-2 and elevated. Contrast 12:1 or more in both themes. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 28px/1.4 "Inter Variable", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -0.015em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/InterVariable-latin.woff2`, `fonts/InterVariable-latin-ext.woff2`, `fonts/JetBrainsMonoVariable-latin.woff2` and `fonts/JetBrainsMonoVariable-latin-ext.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/InterVariable-latin.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/InterVariable-latin.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Inter Variable | `fonts/InterVariable-latin.woff2` (weight 100 900) | `read fonts/InterVariable-latin.woff2` | `var(--font-sans)` | `inter-variable` |
| JetBrains Mono Variable | `fonts/JetBrainsMonoVariable-latin.woff2` (weight 100 800) | `read fonts/JetBrainsMonoVariable-latin.woff2` | `var(--font-mono)` | `jetbrains-mono-variable` |

Every face: `fonts/InterVariable-latin.woff2` (Inter Variable, 100 900), `fonts/InterVariable-latin-ext.woff2` (Inter Variable, 100 900), `fonts/JetBrainsMonoVariable-latin.woff2` (JetBrains Mono Variable, 100 800), `fonts/JetBrainsMonoVariable-latin-ext.woff2` (JetBrains Mono Variable, 100 800).

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 2px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-0-5);
```

### Tokens (11)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |

| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon to label inside chips. |
| `--space-1-5` | 6px | Icon to label inside buttons. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Between buttons in a row, between badges. |
| `--space-2-5` | 10px | Horizontal padding of small buttons, list row gaps. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Padding of rows and callouts. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card body padding; gap between cards. |
| `--space-5` | 20px | Padding of dialogs and drawers. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Page gutter beside the sidebar. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Between page sections. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Empty state padding. |
